environment.description: Application deployed behind AWS ALB with target group routing. ALB listener on port 443 configured with mutual TLS authentication using a trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:XXXX:truststore/internal-ca-bundle/abc123) in 'verify' mode (not 'passthrough'). The trust store contains only the organization's internal PKI intermediate CA certificate. Connection-level mTLS validation occurs at the ALB before any HTTP processing - connections without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA chain are terminated with a TLS handshake failure (no HTTP response generated). The ALB access logs show attribute 'tls_client_cert_subject' populated for all successful requests. Additionally, the target group health check path is /api/v1/health which does not require the X-Action-Type header.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with mutual TLS (verify mode)
config.trust_store_contents: Organization internal PKI intermediate CA only
config.vpc_config: private subnet, no direct internet access to target
